prompt: This flat vector illustration depicts a lively mountain campsite scene. On the left, a tall pine tree with dark green needles stands beside a gray rock formation. Next to the rock, a woman in a blue beanie sits on a folded camping chair, holding a steaming mug of coffee. A small orange cat rests on her lap, looking up at her face. In the center, a large yellow tent is pitched on the grass, its flap open to reveal a sleeping bag inside. Standing next to the tent entrance, a man in a red flannel shirt points toward the sky, where a single white cloud floats. Above him, a brown eagle soars with wings spread wide. To the right of the tent, a black barbecue grill emits thin lines of smoke. A child in a striped sweater stands beside the grill, handing a metal spatula to a man in a green apron who waits with an empty plate. Behind them, a brown dog with floppy ears sniffs at a pile of firewood stacked neatly against a log cabin wall. The cabin has a single window and a chimney. There is no water body visible in the background. There is no vehicle parked near the site. The ground is covered in short green grass with scattered pebbles. The sky is a solid light blue without gradients. All figures are rendered with clean lines and solid colors, typical of the flat vector illustration style.
